Medical inability to open one or both eyes triggers C24 discretionary acceptance. It does not express the separate exception role relative to C23 open-eye guidance.
Unlikely medical cause qualifies the C26 statement request. Rare appears in C26 logic even though omitted from this shorter trigger record.
